items.label: Support External API
items.purpose: Keep the person's route to VexLife Home accessible independently of local/Partner inference readiness, then let one selected VexLife Home intentionally choose local or external Partner model realization while VexLife remains the owner of Home, Conversation, Memory, contextual ground, capability admission and durable turn truth; add truthful provider connection, credential, availability, failure, privacy and qualification semantics; prove the body deterministically without paid API access; and keep real provider qualification as an explicit later gate.

items.purpose: First separate VexLife Home/Product accessibility from selected inference-session readiness so local runtime failure, Partner failure, missing credentials, cache failure, switching or an unconfigured model can hold only dependent inference while the person retains a truthful route to Home, Settings, recovery and another realization. Then form the smallest provider-neutral Direct Companion inference boundary that preserves current local mlx-lm behavior exactly while allowing Local Heretic or Partner realization beneath the same Vex-owned Conversation/Memory/capability turn. Current Warm Boot #518 owns VexLifeProdLocalService.kt plus DirectCompanionConnection/Turn overlap and Response Readiness #573 owns overlapping Companion/runtime cache paths, so do not race those writers; continue only disjoint Home-foundation/current-state source until their accepted results can be inherited. items.label: A1 — Settings Local / Partner model-source topology
items.purpose: Evolve Models so Local / Partner is a presentation filter over canonical model offerings rather than a second durable model-choice truth. #564/#567/#569/#572 now source-form source filtering, narrow Partner profiles, catalog-bound inventory and truthful restart Partner rows. Actual live service composition is held because current Warm Boot #518 owns VexLifeProdLocalService.kt, the route owner for GET /api/v1/models; do not race that writer. When composition opens, Models must remain reachable from the Home-accessible Product body even when no inference realization is currently usable. The live service also still needs a rightful accepted Partner support-proof source rather than hard-coded standing.

items.label: A2 — Partner Provider Connection + credential/account/model contract
items.purpose: Form one truthful Partner connection relationship covering source-owned provider identity, protected host credential custody, durable non-secret Home coordinates, restart currentness and crash-recoverable add/replace/remove convergence without storing secret values in semantic/durable surfaces. #570/#571 source-form persistence/currentness; #575 now adds one durable transition surface (STAGE_CONNECT/STAGE_REPLACE/CLEANUP_REPLACED/REMOVE), preallocation collision proof, recovery without secret replay, durable cleanup debt, and non-secret account-scope update. Repository-native execution and platform lived proof remain owed.

items.label: A3 — OpenAI / Anthropic / Kimi provider adapters
items.purpose: Implement bounded provider realizations that translate the provider-neutral Companion contract into each provider's current request, authentication, streaming, reasoning/content and tool-call/result grammar, then normalize the result back into Vex-owned meaning without spreading vendor wire semantics through Conversation, Memory or capability owners. Product PR #554 now source-forms a provisional pure wire-codec body for OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Kimi Chat Completions on disjoint paths, including exact provider-call identity preservation/result carriage; A3 remains dependency-held because network/credential/provider-session integration still requires A0/A2 and exact JVM execution is owed.

items.label: A4 — Preserve Vex context, Capability Bridge and effective capabilities across providers
items.purpose: Prove that provider switching changes only the model/provider realization: canonical Conversation, Memory, Foundation, bounded prompt context and Capability Atlas/Bridge remain Vex-owned; provider-native tool requests converge into the same canonical Vex capability meaning; and effective capability availability is joined from exact connection/model/profile/Product qualification rather than model names or marketing claims. Product #566 source-forms the generic effective-capability join; #567 now source-forms a narrow representation catalog for gpt-6.2-sol, claude-sonnet-5-5 and kimi-k3 without account/qualification/live claims. Provider-native call identity carriage remains preserved by #554. Full P2 turn proof and capability qualification refs remain unformed.

items.label: A5 — Provider failure, availability and retry semantics
items.purpose: Normalize provider-specific status plus machine error type/code/body and stream-terminal evidence into truthful Vex meanings for invalid credentials, billing/quota holds, permission/model access, rate limits, overload, provider unavailability, invalid requests, context limits, malformed responses and interrupted streams; expose human controls without automatic cross-provider fallback or unsafe replay. Product #560 now source-forms a provisional no-effect mapping from P1 failure meaning into A2 connection currentness, including conservative UNKNOWN service standing for ambiguous stream/response failures and exact provider-identity binding. Acceptance remains dependency-held on current P1/A2 source and exact JVM proof.

items.purpose: Exercise exact provider request/stream/tool/failure fixtures through injected transports and local harnesses so the external-provider consumer body, Settings state, effective capabilities, secret redaction, turn failure semantics and no-fallback laws can be proven without paid API calls; keep all real-provider availability and billing claims explicitly unestablished. A7 itself stays dependency-held until the A0/A1/A2/A3/A4/A5/A6 implementation relationships exist.

items.label: A8 — Real external provider qualification
items.purpose: After deterministic conformance is accepted, run the smallest bounded real provider/model round trip needed to prove the exact credential/account/model/stream/tool relationship claimed live-qualified. This work remains held until a legitimate usable provider credential/account/credit or an explicitly accepted equivalent is available. The Product may still reach an accepted CONTRACT_PROVEN/LIVE_UNQUALIFIED production posture before this gate when release authority accepts it, provided the UI exposes a small accessible information affordance that says live provider validation is pending and does not claim live qualification.

items.label: A9 — Lived local ↔ Partner model switching with one Vex continuity
items.purpose: Prove the human can switch among qualified local and Partner models while one canonical Vex Home, Conversation, Memory and capability relationship persists; Home/Settings remain accessible during switching and failure so the person can recover, choose another realization or return without automatic fallback; each turn reconstructs bounded provider-ready ground through the selected adapter; provider-side history/cache remains execution detail; and failures never cause silent provider fallback or duplicate turn effects.
